new_relations.title: Current perception can be real yet partial
new_relations.project_anchor: The project distinguishes a real source from incomplete reflections, interfaces and observer-limited models.
new_relations.biblical_structure: present knowledge and seeing are described as partial, with mirror imagery contrasting incomplete perception with fuller knowing
new_relations.source_direction: Project reflector/source and observer-access principles first; Pauline comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: The passage concerns Christian maturity and eschatological fullness, not a technical epistemology of screens or models.
